title: Megadrive Collection
description: I'm an avid retro game collector, especially SEGA titles from the 90s. This is a small project I use to learn new technologies once in a while. The first version was a Vue frontend with a Rails API, but these days it's a TanStack Start app with Prisma.

title: oterosantos.com
description: This is the very website you're looking at right now. I built it with TanStack Start and Tailwind CSS, and it's hosted on Netlify.
